headline: Alibaba Cloud Intends to Rely Increasingly on Its Own-Developed AI Chips
summary: Alibaba Cloud intends to rely increasingly on its subsidiary T-Head, which produces AI accelerators. Chief Eddie Wu made the remarks during the company's Q2 2026 earnings report.
why: Alibaba is one of China's largest cloud and e-commerce groups, and in-house AI chips reduce its dependence on outside chip suppliers.
